performance.verdict: Google surge with near-zero leads; six overdue milestones block any scale.

findings.text: 28-day CPL is $252.54 on only 7 attributed leads; Meta holds all 7 while Google Ads logged 12 conversions that never appear in the leads tally — tracking mismatch confirmed.

Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7; booking-bot battle-test (due 2026-07-31), Review Boost campaign, Financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA heating toggle (due 2026-09-01) all overdue — 6 milestones unresolved.
GBP actions hit 0 for the last 9 consecutive days (Aug 31–Sep 7), down from 98 actions in the 28-day window — listing suppression or data outage, not ad performance.

3-day spend signal (Sep 5–7): $44.91 + $42.02 + $150.38 = $237.31 vs prior 3 days (Sep 2–4): $42.63 + $44.10 + $47.38 = $134.11 — Google pushed $107.82 on Sep 7 alone with 1 lead total across all 6 days.
IG reach collapsed to 12–23/day (Sep 4–7) vs 259 on Aug 29 and 337 on Aug 22; with Meta spend still running ~$18–43/day, organic reach has decoupled from spend.

suggestions.text: Audit GBP listing immediately; 9 straight days of 0 actions on a live account requires same-day verification.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have read zero for 9 consecutive days (Aug 31–Sep 7), down from 98 actions in the prior 28-day window. Log into both GBP profiles today, confirm listings are published and not suspended, and check Windsor for data-lag vs native dashboard discrepancy. Success check: native GBP dashboard shows >0 actions by 2026-09-11. If suspended, escalate to Nacer same day.

suggestions.text: Reconcile Google Ads 12 conversions vs 0 leads in GHL; identify pixel or intake path break before any Google budget moves.
suggestions.monday_item_name: Fix Google Conv vs Lead Gap
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads reports 12 conversions in 28 days but the leads tally shows 0 from that channel, and Sep 7 alone spent $107.82 with no attributed leads. Pull the Google Ads conversion action definitions and confirm whether they fire on a thank-you page that routes into GHL. Success check: conversion events and GHL contacts reconcile within 20% by 2026-09-11. Do not increase Google budget until this is resolved.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL and IG reach through Sep 11; no budget move until intake owner is confirmed and scale-up gate is cleared.
suggestions.monday_update: IG reach has dropped to 12–23/day against ~$18–43/day Meta spend, and 6 SOW milestones remain overdue including intake owner confirmation, which is the explicit scale-up gate. No Meta budget changes this cycle. Re-check on 2026-09-11: if intake owner is confirmed and reach recovers above 100/day, escalate to Sohib for a creative refresh discussion.
